caption:
3 signs your idea should be an app 📱

1️⃣ People use it every day
2️⃣ It has to work with no signal
3️⃣ It holds private info

Money Path is an Android app we built that ticks all 3: what's left up front, spend alerts, works with no internet, PIN lock and the data encrypted on the phone.
